notes.title: Land of War: The Beginning Patch 1.3
notes.content:
Hello Players,

We want to respond to player feedback as soon as possible, so we present to you the content of the patch 1.3, upgrading the version of Land of War to version 1.3.1570 Below you will find a list of fixes introduced in this update.

- Restored Nazi-related symbols, excluding markets where such symbols are forbidden
- New animations for NPC damage and deaths
- Enemies will now drop P08 handgun

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/b4760d27f7bcb0531b4f0545b75ef788aefe0fe4.jpg

- Addition od Sturmpistole gun as a free DLC available in main menu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/259174bb003c3619291d7413bdad9fcd95404cf8.jpg

- Fixed lighting issues in the last bunker of first mission - Mokra - "The Beginning"
- Improved clouds visuals in "To the Heaven" mission
- Improved fire visuals in Warsaw - "Hold the Line"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/e3660ce2f83ae30a8637153cefaaa19058fc63f0.png

- Added waypoints on swamp passage in Kampinos - "Iron Chest"
- Game no longer crashes when player falls into the water in "Iron Chest" mission
- Fixed ranks on NPC uniforms
- Improved terrain collision above tunnel in "Death from Above" mission
- Added prompt informing player about full equipment when trying to pick a medkit up
- Improved player vehicle sounds in second mission - "Against All Odds"
- Removed Matt's duplicate dialogue in "Dante's Inferno" mission
- Improved UI animations in save menu
- Restored missing forest parts in "Iron Chest" mission
- Fixed issues with projector playback during collectibles inspection
- Improved enemy behaviour during ambush in last mission
- "Death from Above" optimization
- Fixed "Land of War" achievement
- Improved hand animations during opening cutscene
- Fixed bug causing player to get stuck in stationary weapon after dying during exit animation
- Improved sound effects' distances
- Sound memory usage optimized
- Improved collision on bomb craters in Mokra - "Unexpected Visitors"
- Allies hit by player react with damage animations
- Improved sabre collision
- Added new textures for traitors' models in "Hold the Line" mission
- Further improvement of screenshake settings

We hope the update improves your experience with Land of War: The Beginning. Thank you for your trust.

notes.title: Land of War - The Beginning patch 1.1
notes.content:
Dear Gamers,

The time around the premiere is a time of hard work for us. We collected all the feedback from you, the players, and prepared a patch that will solve most of the urgent issues. 
The patch is called v1.1, the changelog is available below. 

Improvements

• The in-game tutorial for grenades has been added
• The ability to select the force of Camera Shake for the Incoming Hits has been added
• Two game modes have been added – Classic Mode and Casual Mode (reduced damage, faster health regeneration, lower frequency of enemy attacks).
• Several fixes to dialogues have been added to the Hold the Line map
• Dead bodies on the Hold the Line map fixed
• Fixes for handling custom game controllers have been added
• Explosion impact improved

Fixes

• Added option for reversed mouse axis
• Save system improvements
• The behavior of medics on the Hold the Line map has been corrected
• The environment on the Dante’s Inferno map has been improved
• Fixed some visual artifacts on The Beginning map
• The rotation speed of the guns on the armored train has been increased
• Improved camera operation during sequences with an armored train
• The range of combat zones on The Beginning map has been corrected to prevent a death loop at the start of a location
• The Admiral's conversation animation on the English version of The Almo‘39 has been improved
• The behavior of the Admiral on The Almo‘39 has been corrected
• The pyrotechnic effects on the Almo‘39 map have been corrected
• Blocker in the sewer tunnel has been removed (Dante’s Inferno map)
• The size of shield collisions has been corrected in various places in the game
• The movement of the character's mouth on the Hold the Line map has been corrected
• Several dialogue lines have been improved
• The visuals on The Beginning map have been improved - the drawing range of vegetation has been increased
• The lighting on The Beginning map in the bunker has been corrected
• Lighting fixes have been added to the Death from Above map
• Added Amendments to the naming of military ranks in German

We don't want to finish over here, but provide you more updates and continue to collect your feedback. We're aware that some things may have been better here or there, but we're not hiding. In fact, we thank you for all your support and want to improve the game further. More information below.


Patch 1.2 (planned date 16th of June)
 
• Performance and memory usage improvements
• Fire FX improved
• Sound system improvements
• Localisation fixes
• Multiple animations improvements
• Overall balance improvements
• Stability fixes
• Multiple fixes to prevent users to go outside of the map area

We hope that this update will improve your experience with the Land of War game. 
Thank you for supporting us, we’ll continue to bring the updates. 

MS Games Team

notes.title: Pre-alpha gameplay teaser
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We would like to thank you for your comments and engagement. It is very motivating for us as a team to see this kind of involvement with our future players.

We would like to show you our first video straight from the front line. The gameplay is early pre-alpha and does not reflect the final look of the product.

[previewyoutube=tfJs56dcuUA;full][/previewyoutube]

Currently, we're working on some fundamental changes like:

- Animations - we decided to go back to the drawing board and cooperate with few talented animators to create animations that will not differ from the flagship FPS products,

- Sound production - we are currently at the stage of creating a sound system,

- Scene lighting - change of post-processes and atmospheric effects.

See you on the front lines!

notes.title: Developer’s Diary no. 1 LAND OF WAR LEVEL DESIGN
notes.content:
Location design is a major element of any game development project. Our aim here at Land of War development team is to create locations which are as close to real battlefields of September 1939 Poland as possible but also provide interesting and dynamic gameplay so typical for old school FPS shooters.

Good research is a key

We always start with thorough research. If possible (and feasible) we visit the physical location of a battlefield we are working on, see local museums or displays and talk to custodians of such places. We take lots of pictures! Next, we come back to the office and start creating the land. Then we apply white boxes and cylinders representing various objects, vehicles or army units. In this way we can roughly sketch the gameplay and decide to modify the land in order to make it more suitable for our needs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/fdfae4313de551598c591ce5725aff4f7ba6e441.jpg

How we create locations for Land of War?

Another stage is to enrich the environment of our location with objects such as  vegetation, trenches, creeks, chapels, anything we find necessary to make it interesting and supporting the main mission as well as any side tasks. And the we test, test, test to make sure players will be provided with hours of quality playtime.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/c48fdbae3d7545c48a544b76ceaee188ac0f8f37.jpg

“We believe that such approach to level design will make Land of War a very unique experience for everyone looking for games taking place during WWII” – says Bartosz Romanowski, Land of War Level Designer.

Thanks to such framework, we pay a lot of attention to each location in Land of War and make it highly playable. We also take care that each of them contains some specific places, buildings, vehicles and weapons that have never been used in WWII games before. It is these details – we believe – that will make Land of War special and rich with new experiences for all players.
